headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 15, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs secured a shutout victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, winning 3-0 behind Seiya Suzuki's 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Abner Uribe, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Colt Emerson (Seattle Mariners), Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox), Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants), Trevor McDonald (San Francisco Giants), Garrett Whitlock (Boston Red Sox), James Outman (Detroit Tigers), and Endy Rodríguez (Pittsburgh Pirates).

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Kansas City Royals have also made a trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a shutout victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, winning 3-0. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound, tossing 7.0 innings of shutout baseball.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, and 2 BB. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Boston Red Sox sent Rivas to the Orioles in exchange for a player to be named later.
